title: Weight-or-Size List Charge of a Checked Bag — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Baggage acceptance charging clause — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The bag concerned is the heaviest bag carrying a first, second or third bag charge on the ticket's first unflown segment (the segment numbered one more than the coupons already flown). The bag's recorded weight, size and check-in channel are those of its bag charge.

## The clause

The weight list charge is zero when the weight counted is at most the fare brand's weight allowance, the first overweight band fee when it is above the allowance and at most the first band limit, and the second overweight band fee when it is above the first band limit; the size list charge is zero when the recorded size is at most the standard linear inches and the oversize fee otherwise; the bag's weight-or-size list charge is the higher of the two, and only that component is recorded.

The weight counted is the recorded weight, and the weight-or-size charge posted is the weight-or-size list charge rounded to the cent.

The weight allowance, first band limit, band fees, standard linear inches and oversize fee are those of the ticket's fare brand in its baggage acceptance standard.

## Decision table

| Weight counted | Weight list charge |
|---|---|
| At most the allowance | Zero |
| Above the allowance, at most the first band limit | First overweight band fee |
| Above the first band limit | Second overweight band fee |

| Recorded size | Size list charge |
|---|---|
| At most the standard linear inches | Zero |
| Above the standard linear inches | Oversize fee |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Suppose an allowance of 50 lb, a band limit of 70 lb, band fees of 110 and 210 dollars, a standard size of 62 inches and an oversize fee of 190 dollars. A bag recorded at 64 lb and 60 inches has a weight list charge of 110 and a size list charge of zero; the weight-or-size charge posted is 110.00 dollars, recorded as the weight component. A bag recorded at 48 lb and 70 inches has a size list charge of 190 and a weight list charge of zero; 190.00 dollars is posted as the size component.
